scope_notes.maximum: Dual headline values are bound to the same circuit/seed. Geomeans use a common complete cohort.
scope_notes.runtime: Parallel sweep timings are raw observations only; use serial_summary for performance conclusions.
scope_notes.paper_baseline: Published LaZagna VTR8.1 has a different author2D denominator; no direct absolute ratio is calculated.
scope_notes.physical: Derived common-plane architecture family; logical capacity matching does not establish equal area/power/via budgets.

algorithm_diagnostics.scope: Descriptive arithmetic mean of legal-run fractions, with valid-run and registered-role counts; not CPD statistics. Different roles may alias one actual run.
algorithm_diagnostics.interpretation: Delay-scored pins require enough forward/reverse-covered candidates for K alternatives. No delay query (e.g. geometry variant) is missing/not applicable, not zero coverage. A bounded-search truncation is not an infeasibility certificate.
